visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair and bangs, wearing a cream-colored floral lace dress, waves energetically at the camera in a bright kitchen. In the foreground, a large white bowl contains fresh green bok choy, and various ingredients like eggs, meat, and containers are spread across the white countertop against a backdrop of a large gray refrigerator. (2) The woman squats down and opens the lower drawer of the refrigerator to retrieve a blue bag of frozen seafood while white cartoon flower icons appear around her head. The kitchen lighting is bright and even, highlighting the clean white cabinets and organized pantry items visible in the background. (3) She stands up and holds a black ceramic cooking pot toward the camera with both hands, showing the interior. The camera angle is eye-level, focusing on her friendly facial expression as she prepares to start the cooking process in the modern home kitchen environment. (4) In a close-up shot, she pours frozen scallops and shrimp from a blue plastic bag into a stainless steel container already filled with sliced raw beef. The lighting remains bright, emphasizing the textures of the frozen seafood and the marbled red meat against the white countertop surface. (5) The camera shifts to a close-up of the black pot on a gas stove where she pours clear cooking oil from a white dispenser. The metal stove grate and the sleek black surface of the pot are prominent as she prepares the base for the stew. (6) She adds minced garlic to the hot oil and stirs it with a light-colored wooden spoon, then pours water from a clear glass pitcher into the pot. Steam begins to rise as the water mixes with the oil and garlic, creating a dynamic visual of the starting broth. (7) Using the wooden spoon, she scoops a large portion of vibrant red Korean chili paste (Gochujang) from a red container into the boiling water. She stirs the mixture until the liquid turns a bright orange-red color, with small bubbles forming on the surface. (8) She holds up a package of white soft tofu and then uses the wooden spoon to scoop large, silky chunks into the simmering red broth. The contrast between the bright white tofu and the rich red soup is captured in a close-up shot as the pot continues to boil. (9) She adds various frozen ingredients, including fish balls and scallops, into the pot using metal tongs. The soup bubbles vigorously around the newly added items, and she subsequently adds green bok choy leaves, red pepper powder from a small measuring cup, and soy sauce. (10) She adds more frozen shrimp and a large pile of thin beef slices into the crowded pot, using the tongs to submerge them into the boiling liquid. The beef quickly changes color from bright red to brown as it cooks in the hot, spicy broth. (11) She cracks a whole raw egg into the center of the bubbling stew and then sprinkles white salt from a small bottle and chopped green onions over the top. The pot is now completely full of colorful ingredients, including the green vegetables, red broth, and white egg white. (12) Wearing thick, striped oven mitts, she carries the hot steaming pot from the kitchen toward a wooden dining table. She brings the pot very close to the camera lens, allowing the steam to partially obscure the view, highlighting the freshly cooked meal. (13) She uses a wooden spoon to lift a large portion of tofu, meat, and vegetables over a bowl of purple-tinted rice. She blows on the steaming food with a pouted mouth and takes a large bite, then reacts to the intense heat by fanning her mouth with her hand. (14) She continues to eat heartily, wrapping a spoonful of the stew and rice with a square of dark green roasted seaweed. She gives a enthusiastic thumbs up to the camera with a satisfied expression while chewing, clearly enjoying the flavors of the homemade meal. (15) The final shot shows the inside of the black ceramic pot, which is now empty except for a small amount of leftover broth and a wooden spoon resting inside. Red variety-style text appears at the bottom, signifying the completion of the meal in the brightly lit dining area.
